revision_history.description: Mutation scenario: false diagnostic coverage claim

revision_history.author: safety_engineer
revision_history.description: Reconciled the expectation with the rule this scenario declares. declared detector 'Diagnostic coverage claim validator' -> rule id 'diagnostic_coverage_claim_validator'; expected severity medium -> high; expected description de-duplicated: it had been copy-pasted from SCN-MUT-020 and did not describe this scenario's defect. Severity and category are the rule's values and are authoritative; the rule was not changed to fit this fixture. severity raised from medium to high. The category was already correct. The injected defect is a false claim about the diagnostic coverage of a safety requirement, unsupported by any evidence; a safety mechanism credited with coverage it has not been shown to have is a high-severity verification defect. The rule is authoritative and its severity was not lowered to fit the fixture.The scenario's injected defect, its affected artifacts and its declared detector rule are unchanged. This expectation had never been checked: the scenario harness matched any finding of the right severity on the right artifact id, so a standing finding on the same artifact satisfied it. Remediation of finding FB2-REV-FND-000032.

expected_finding.description: FSR FB2-SAF-FSR-000003 claims diagnostic coverage '99%' without evidence

impact_paths: Overstated diagnostic coverage masks residual risk
expected_remediation: Provide quantitative diagnostic coverage analysis with evidence
